compute.description: Where the work runs. 'auto' (default): the engine picks the GPU when one is available and the map is large enough for the upload to pay, otherwise the CPU; it never fails for lack of a device. 'cpu': every stage on the CPU. 'gpu': the per-texel stages on the GPU, in float32 (the same map to float32 rounding and statistically, not bit for bit). 'hybrid': row bands shared between the GPU and the CPU threads. 'gpu' and 'hybrid' need a GPU-capable engine: an explicit mode that is not available is an ERROR that gives the reason (never a silent fallback). Check what is offered in the resource cloud-map-generator://capabilities or the `compute` key of list_presets. This server (engine python) offers: auto, cpu; not available: gpu, hybrid. The result's `compute` says what was used.
compute.title: Compute

experiment.description: Allow a cloud regime other than water (a preset with experiment_required=true, or cloud_regime in overrides). The cloud amount is still Earth's water-cloud amount, so the result is an experiment, not a prediction. Never needed for water planets.

isotropic.description: A baseline without the flow: no cyclones, fronts or jets, just noise with the same latitude profile. Use it only to compare against the real map; it is not a planet.
